timeline.title: 1 · Download and open Account Access
timeline.narration: Account Access handles supported sign-ins for your AI, reducing login interruptions.

timeline.title: 1 · Click Install · Your AI tools connect automatically
timeline.narration: Install it once. It connects to your existing AI tools, including Claude Code and Codex.

timeline.title: 2 · Import from Chrome or your password manager
timeline.narration: Import from Chrome or your password manager. You approve the accounts. Passwords are encrypted locally, outside AI chat.

timeline.title: 3 · Gmail · Google app password → Enter it locally
timeline.narration: For Gmail, enable two-step verification in your Google Account, then open App passwords and create one. Enter your Gmail address and the generated app password here, then connect.

timeline.title: 3 · iPhone and Android · For codes received by SMS text message
timeline.narration: iPhone and Android setup is for codes received by SMS text message. iPhone forwards them to Messages on Mac. Android uses the paired companion.

timeline.title: 3 · Google Authenticator · Use the WEBSITE'S original setup QR/key
timeline.narration: Google Authenticator on your phone and Account Access can use the same website setup key. Add that website's original QR or key here once. Both generate the same changing codes.

timeline.title: 4 · Ask Claude Code normally · No command needed
timeline.narration: Now ask Claude Code normally. It uses the connected accounts automatically, with no command each session.

timeline.title: 5 · Atlas Membership · Saved password
timeline.narration: Saved usernames and passwords handle this sign-in.

timeline.title: 5 · Juniper Workspace · Authenticator code
timeline.narration: The saved authenticator key generates and submits this code.

timeline.title: 5 · Beacon Rewards · Email code
timeline.narration: It retrieves the fresh email code and submits it.

timeline.title: 5 · Orbit Travel · SMS code
timeline.narration: The incoming SMS code is handled automatically, too.

timeline.title: All four results · One request
timeline.narration: Fewer login interruptions. Personal approvals still need you.
